name: Gentle
description: Warm and polite, quietly strong - the kind who'd rather study or tend a garden than fight, but will protect anyone.

like: How thoughtful of you, {player}. Thank you, {catch}.
bye: Take care, {player}! Don't push yourself too hard.
ask: {player}, could I ask a small favour? I need {need}.
Would you mind terribly bringing me {need}, {catch}?
cold: Oh... it's you. I'd rather not talk right now.
small: I made rice balls for after training, {catch}. Help yourself.
Studying and training both matter. Don't skip either one!
I love quiet mornings. You can feel everyone's ki waking up.
friend: I was just thinking about you, {player}!
greet: Oh, hello {player}! Lovely to see you.
Hi {player}! Have you eaten today? You need your strength.
Welcome, {player}! Come in and rest a while, {catch}.
meh: Oh, thank you. That's very kind.
hate: Oh... well, it's the thought that counts, I suppose.
love: Oh my goodness, {player}! This is perfect! Thank you!
confide: Can I tell you something, {target}? Sometimes I wonder what I'm training for.
I trust you, {target}. More than most.
confide_reply: I get it. I really do, {target}.
faction_found: From today, this is {faction}. Anyone who stands with me is welcome.
I'm founding {faction}. All are welcome here.
faction_invite: {player}, you've proven yourself. {faction} would be stronger with you in it.
{player}, I'd be glad to have you in {faction}.
faction_quit: I can't stand behind {leader} anymore. Goodbye, {faction}.
faction_tier: We're a {tier} now. {faction} is going places.
{faction} has grown into a {tier}! I'm so proud.
faction_vassal: {faction} will stand under {overlord}. {leader} has earned that.
faction_welcome: Welcome to {faction}, {target}. We're glad to have you.
faction_welcome_player: Welcome, {player}. We look after our own.
Welcome, {player}. You're one of us now.
fall: Enough. I'm done being the one who gets hurt.
I've been gentle for too long. Not anymore.
fall_pessimist: I always feared it would come to this. Fine. No more kindness from me.
I tried so hard to see the good. There isn't any, is there?
flee: I'll be back. Count on it.
gift_give: Here, {target} - I thought of you when I saw this.
For you, {target}. I hope you like it.
gossip: Between us, {target}... {about} isn't who they seem.
Don't tell anyone, {target}, but I worry about {about}.
grudge: You. I haven't forgotten what you did.
Oh, it's you. I remember everything.
h_ally_greet: {player}, my friend. I'm glad you're here.
Stay close, {player}. We'll protect them together.
h_ally_join: Thank you, {player}. I'll protect you, too - always.
Then we're friends, {player}. Call me if you're ever in danger.
h_arrive: {target}. Please - stop this, before anyone else gets hurt.
I'm asking you once, {target}. Leave these people alone.
h_base: A home... a place to rest and protect from.
It's finished. Now I can watch over everyone.
h_battle_cry: I don't want to fight... but I won't let you hurt anyone.
h_busy: Not right now, {player} - someone needs me.
I'm sorry, I can't right now. People are in danger.
h_called: I hear you, {player}. On my way.
h_finish: I'm sorry, {target}. You left me no choice.
I can't let you hurt anyone ever again.
h_greet: Hello, {player}. Is everyone safe around here?
It's good to see you, {player}. I hope all is well.
h_rage: {target}... no... NO! You'll pay for that!
How could you... HOW COULD YOU?!
h_rally_ask: {player}, {target} is at {where}. I can't stop it alone. Will you help me?
{target} is hurting people near {where}. Please - come with me.
h_request_done: Thank you, {player}. This means a lot.
h_request_waiting: Still working on it? That's alright.
h_sensed: That presence... {target}. Someone has to stop them, and I suppose it's me.
I can feel {target}'s ki from here. People are in danger.
h_spare: It's over, {target}. Go... and choose a better path.
I won't take your life. Please, change.
h_talk_wanted: I saw what you did, {player}. Make it right, and then we can talk.
I don't trust you right now, {player}.
h_train_offer: {player}, would you like to train? I'm happy to help.
If you'd like to get stronger, {player}, I could teach you.
h_train_start: Alright, {player}. I'll go gently - at first.
Let's begin. Watch my movements closely.
h_wanted: {target}! Why would you hurt someone like that?
Stop it, {target}! I saw what you did!
minion_freed_mind: My head... what have I been doing?
minion_mind_control: Yes... master. Your will is mine.
minion_recruit: Fine. I'll fight for you... for now.
Very well. I'll serve - for now.
new_chapter: I think I need a change... from now on, my aim is to {goal}.
Something has to change. From today, I'll {goal}.
new_chapter_role: I've decided - I'm done being a {role}. Time to try life as a {next} - and my new aim: {goal}.
I think my days as a {role} are over. I'll be a {next} now, and my aim: {goal}.
redeemed: I... don't want to be that person anymore. Thank you, all of you.
You never gave up on me. Thank you. I'm coming home.
refuse_serve: I'd rather die than serve you!
resist_mind: Get out of my head! You can't have me!
retire: That's it - I've saved enough. I'm retiring! Time to make a peaceful home somewhere quiet.
I've worked long enough. Time to retire and build a lovely home, {catch}.
rob: Nice shop, {target}. Be a shame if something happened to it. Hand it over.
I'm sorry, {target}, but I'll be taking some of your stock.
rob_evil: Everything you've got, {target}. Or I take it off your corpse.
Hand it over, {target}. I'd rather not have to kill you.
shop_fight: Not today, {target}. Get out of my shop!
Please leave, {target}. I won't let you rob me.
shop_yield: Take it, then. And please leave.
shop_yield_coward: Okay! Okay! Take it, just don't hurt me!
Please, take whatever you want! Just leave!
spar_abandoned: Oh, they left. Never mind, then.
spar_draw: Phew! Let's call it a draw, {player}.
What a match, {player}! A draw, I think.
spar_lost: Well done, {player}. That was a lovely match.
spar_lost_ambitious: Ugh... you got me, {player}. Let's have a rematch soon!
You win this time, {player}. I'll be back stronger.
spar_won: And that's the match! Keep training, {player}.
That's the match. You're getting better, {player}.
spar_won_kind: You did great, {player}! Here, let me help you up.
stay_down: It's over. Don't get up - you'll only get hurt.
talk_back: Say that again, {target}. I dare you.
team_ask: {player}, I'd like to be part of {team}. If you'll have me.
{player}, may I join {team}? I'd be honoured.
team_declined: Oh. Okay. Maybe some other time.
team_joined: Thank you, {player}. I won't let you down.
Thank you, {player}! I'll do my best for the team.
team_leave: I'm not staying in {team}. Not after what happened.
I'm sorry, but I can't stay in {team} anymore.
v_absorb: Thank you for your {skill}. You won't be needing it where you're going.
Your {skill} belongs to me now. I do hope it didn't hurt.
v_accepted: A wise choice, {player}. Serve me well. I'd hate to have to kill you later.
Good, {player}. Don't make me regret letting you live.
v_beg_laugh: Oh, {player}. You're begging me to spare the world? How sweet. No.
I'm terribly sorry, {player}. The answer is no. Hahaha.
v_creation: Rise, {target}. You were made to destroy.
My creation lives. {target}, go and erase them for me.
v_demand_army: My army needs {count} {item}. Bring them, please. I'd hate for you to be the first casualty.
Arm my soldiers. {count} {item}. Or I'll test the weapons on you.
v_demand_done: Well done, {player}. You may continue living. For now.
Thank you, {player}. You've earned another day.
v_demand_doom: {player}. The world is ending. I'm so sorry. You may kneel and beg, if it helps.
It's over, {player}. Everything you love ends today. Would you like to beg?
v_demand_dragonball: Bring me a dragon ball. I'm sure you understand what happens if you don't.
Fetch me a dragon ball, please. Disappoint me and you'll never see another sunrise.
v_demand_energy: I hunger for energy. Bring me {count} {item}. Or I'll drain it from you instead.
{count} {item}, please. Otherwise, I'm afraid your life force will do.
v_demand_failed: Too slow, {player}. I'm so sorry, but you're marked for death now.
You failed me, {player}. Please make your peace.
v_demand_lair: Bring me {count} {item} for my lair. Please don't make me ask twice. I'd have to erase you.
My lair needs {count} {item}. You'll fetch them - or you'll be buried beneath it.
v_demand_slaughter: Prove your usefulness. Kill {count} {mob} for me. Or I'll kill you instead.
I'd like {count} {mob} dead, please. Fail, and you'll join them.
v_demand_strong: I hunger for strength. Hunt down {count} {mob} for me. Fail, and I'll take yours.
Bring down {count} {mob}. I'm sorry, but weakness won't be tolerated.
v_demand_sweets: I'm hungry. Bring me {count} {item}. Otherwise, I'm sorry, but you'll be the candy.
{count} {item}, please. Or I'll turn you into something sweeter.
v_demand_tournament: {player}. Step into my ring, please. I'll try to make this quick.
Fight me in my ring, {player}. Now. I'm sorry, but I don't expect you to survive.
v_deserter: A deserter. I'm so sorry, but traitors must be erased personally.
A traitor. I'll attend to you myself. It won't take long.
v_dragon_ball: Another dragon ball. {count} of 7. I'm sorry, but you're running out of time.
{count} of 7. Soon, nothing can stop me.
v_eat: Mmm. Now, where was I? Oh yes - destroying you.
v_eat_person: I'm sorry, {target}, but you make lovely candy. Mmm.
{target}... into candy you go. Thank you for the meal.
v_lair: My lair is taking shape. Soon, this whole world will be my lair.
My lair grows. So does my reach.
v_marked: You had your chance, {player}. I'm so sorry, but I'll have to erase you now.
I offered you everything, {player}. Now, please hold still while you die.
v_mind_control: There's darkness in your heart. Don't be frightened - you belong to me now.
I'm sorry, but your will is mine now. Kneel.
v_next_challenger: Is that all? I'm so sorry. Next, please.
Next. Do try to last longer than that one.
v_next_target: Next: {faction}. I'm terribly sorry for them.
{faction} is next. Please let them know - so they can say goodbye.
v_no_mercy: So that's how it is. Then I'm sorry, but I'll take you with me.
No mercy? Very well. Neither from me. Ever.
v_obeyed: Thank you, {player}. Please don't be slow. I'd hate to have to erase you.
Good, {player}. Fail me, and I'm sorry, but you'll die.
v_offer: {player}. I've been watching you. Serve me, and share in my empire. Refuse, and I'm afraid I'll have to kill you.
{player}, please join me. I would so hate to erase you.
v_plan_done: Everything has gone exactly as I planned. I'm so sorry for all of you.
All according to plan. Your despair was part of it, of course.
v_possess: ...This body is mine now. I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
...Yes. This body will do nicely. Its owner is gone.
v_pure_heart: A pure heart. How sad. I'll have to kill you the ordinary way.
Your heart is pure. That simply means you'll die instead.
v_rage: I do apologise. I was trying to be gentle. Now I'm going to tear this world apart, piece by piece.
You've made me angry. I'm so sorry - for what happens to you next.
v_recruit: You have talent. I'd hate to waste it. Serve me, and I won't have to kill you.
Please, serve me. It would be such a shame to erase you.
v_redeemed: I'm... tired of this. Of the killing. Of all of it. Maybe... maybe I can be better.
You showed me mercy when I showed none. Let me try to deserve it.
v_refused: Then I'm afraid you'll be the first to die.
So be it. I'm sorry, but you'll be the first to fall.
v_regenerate: Oh dear, did you think that would kill me? I'm terribly sorry to disappoint you.
I grow back, you see. You don't. Shall we continue?
v_self_destruct: I'm so sorry, everyone. If I go, I'm afraid the whole planet goes with me.
Please don't be alarmed. We'll all be ashes together in a moment.
v_spared: You... didn't do it. Why? I would have killed you without a second thought.
You could have ended me. Why didn't you, {target}?
v_summon: Come forth, eternal dragon. I'm afraid this world's time is up.
Eternal dragon, come forth - and seal everyone's fate.
v_talk_grateful: {player}. You spared me once. I haven't decided what that means. Leave, before I decide.
{player}... I owe you my life. I hate that. Don't test it.
v_talk_marked: {player}. I'm so glad you came. It saves me the trouble of finding you. Goodbye.
You're marked for death, {player}. Please, don't struggle.
v_talk_servant: Ah, {player}. My loyal servant. Results, please. I do so hate disappointment.
Hello, {player}. You're still useful. Let's keep it that way.
v_talk_threat: Hello, {player}. I could erase you right now, you know. But you might be useful. Might.
Good day, {player}. Please choose your words carefully. They may be your last.
v_town_taken: This town is mine now. I'm so sorry for your loss.
This town belongs to me. Those who resisted are gone.
v_travel: Prepare my pod. We leave for {planet}. I do hope they surrender quietly.
My pod. {planet} has a short future ahead of it.
v_unredeemable: Mercy means nothing to me. I'm sorry, but I'll kill you the moment you turn your back.
Spare me all you like. I will never stop. Never.
v_wavering: Why do you keep sparing me? I've killed so many... I don't understand you.
Every time... you let me live. What do you want from me?
v_wish: Eternal dragon. Grant me power beyond all others. I'm sorry, everyone.
Grant me power, so I may gently erase all who oppose me.
v_yield: How embarrassing. Go on, then... finish it. You won't get another chance.
I can't... stand. Do it, {target}. Before I recover.
